fields.label: Field Name for Values of Precipitation Rate
fields.help: Indicate the field name for the time-varying values of precipitation rate.

fields.label: Static Value for Precipitation Rate (m/day)
fields.help: Enter a single value of precipitation rate to use throughout your model run [the default value of 0.0041 is a health-protective value resulting in constant rainfall totalling approximately 1.5 meters/year. 1.5 m/yr approximates the 95th percentile of annual average precipitation for 824 meteorological stations across the United States. This percentile was derived from 1981–2010 30-year normal values where available (for 813 stations), and otherwise from the January 1–December 31, 2016 period. 30-year normal values were from: Durre, I., M. F. Squires, R. S. Vose, X. Yin, A. Arguez, and S. Applequist, 2012: NOAA's 1981-2010 U.S. Climate Normals: Monthly Precipitation, Snowfall, and Snow Depth. Journal of Applied Meteorology and Climatology, 52, 2377–2395, doi:10.1175/JAMC-D-13-051.1. Available online at: http://dx.doi.org/10.1175/JAMC-D-13-051.1.].

fields.label: Field Name for Values of Cumulative Precipitation

fields.label: Static Value for Cumulative Precipitation (m)
